# Vk4y — VK.com Photo Album Downloader

> Vk4y (https://vk4y.ru) is a free, open-source, browser-based tool for downloading photo albums from VK.com (VKontakte) as ZIP archives. It runs 100% client-side: photos are fetched from VK and packed into ZIP files directly in the user's browser. There is no server side, nothing is uploaded anywhere, and no personal data is collected. Interface available in Russian (default) and English.

Key facts:

- Free, no paid plans, no subscriptions, no hidden fees. Open source: https://github.com/morovinger/vk4y
- Fully client-side (static site on GitHub Pages). Photos and the VK access token never leave the user's browser.
- Login happens through the official VK OAuth window on vk.com; the site never sees the user's password. The access token is stored in a browser cookie and can be revoked at any time.
- Downloads private albums (owner only), wall photos, and profile photos. The "Saved photos" album cannot be downloaded because VK does not grant third-party apps access to it; the workaround is to move those photos into a regular album first (e.g. via vk.com/movephotos).
- No hard size limits: large albums are automatically split into multiple ZIP archives of up to 1500 photos each. The highest-resolution version of every photo is selected.
- Optional metadata export: likes, comments, tags, and dates for each photo.
- How to use: log in with VK, paste a link to an albums page or a single album from vk.com, press Check, select albums, press Download.

## Pages

- [Main page (Russian)](https://vk4y.ru/): paste an album URL, select albums, download ZIP
- [Main page (English)](https://vk4y.ru/en)
- [About & FAQ (Russian)](https://vk4y.ru/about): safety, VK login, saved photos, size limits, troubleshooting
- [About & FAQ (English)](https://vk4y.ru/en/about)

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/morovinger/vk4y): full source code (Nuxt 3 / Vue 3, TypeScript), issues and bug reports welcome
